Record a Trade

Enter a closed trade or import MT5 history. The journal automatically labels positive P/L as Win, negative P/L as Loss, and zero as Breakeven. Actual RR = net P/L ÷ risk amount.

Import MT5 / CSV Trade History

Upload a CSV exported from MT5 or another journal. The importer will try to recognize common column names. Review the preview before importing.

Choose CSV file
